notes: NAME-VARIANT RESOLUTION was the main task here. Apollo publishes her under three different spellings of the same person: 'Dr Shilpareddy Keesara' (one word - the region/hyderabad, doctors and corporate pages, matching the input row exactly), 'Dr. Shilpa Reddy Keesara' (two words - the Apollo Cancer Centres video and other directories), and 'Dr. Shilpa Reddy K' (abbreviated - the Apollo 24|7 booking page). All three resolve to one radiation oncologist at Apollo, Hyderabad, specialising in gynaecological/genitourinary cancers and brachytherapy, so they are treated as one identity. Identity matched on four criteria: name + specialty (Radiation Oncology) + hospital (Apollo, Jubilee Hills / Apollo Cancer Centres Hyderabad) + city. SPECIALTY REFINEMENT: the input row says 'Oncology'; she is specifically a RADIATION oncologist (DNB Radiation Oncology), not a medical or surgical oncologist. NO CONTACT DETAILS RECORDED: no professional email, no phone, no LinkedIn and no personal or clinic website surfaced across the query variations run. Apollo publishes no per-doctor phone or email, so those fields are blank rather than guessed, and Apollo's central switchboard was not recorded as her line. BAND: Medium - apollohospitals.com (three page families), apollo247.com and the Apollo Cancer Centres YouTube channel are ALL the same Apollo group source and count once; HexaHealth and BanglaHealthConnect are corroborating only. No government, university or scholarly source surfaced, so there is no independent official second source and High is not justified. Apollo's cancer-treatment-centres page family serves title/URL mismatches, so nothing from it is recorded - only URLs whose slug matches her own name.
